hypothesis: A conservative scalar integer SASS and ELF text lifter can recover executable CUDA C++ on the same binary-derived inputs already passed by CuLifter, without original PTX or source as translation inputs.

baseline.candidateCapabilityBefore: Executable PTX recovery; no executable SASS recovery

frozenAcceptance.confirmation: Independent evaluator freezes six new synthetic source/oracle specifications before candidate results and native SASS/ELF/cubin bytes before evaluating the frozen candidate. Unsupported counts remain in the denominator. Reuse after a repair is regression evidence.

scope.input: One kernel's NVIDIA cuobjdump SASS and ELF text, each bounded to 256 KiB
scope.semantics: Explicit scalar 32-bit registers and 64-bit pairs, validated parameter ABI, integer arithmetic, global memory, predicates and supported control flow
scope.unsupported: Float, shared memory, synchronization, atomics, calls and unknown instruction or modifier semantics return no code
scope.systemState: Dead stack setup must be proved unused. Canonical descriptor setup requires an explicit reviewed CUDA flat-global-memory assumption; no fake register values.

ownership.integration: Root integration worktree: MCP wrapper, ADR, documentation, package checks
ownership.backend: Isolated backend worktree: new SASS module and focused tests only
ownership.evaluation: Independent evaluator worktree: frozen fixtures and harnesses only
ownership.review: Independent adversarial worktree: ABI/security probes and review only
ownership.gpu: Existing sole ruOS GPU operator after source and evaluator review

rollback: Revert only new SASS recovery commits on the existing draft. Keep PTX recovery and historical receipts unchanged. Destroy any task-owned rental and independently verify absence. No merge, package release or deployment.
broaderGate: ADR-0009 and the frozen 100-kernel comparison policy remain unchanged. Four development programs or six new synthetic kernels cannot prove superiority.
